body:
I love ambien. And I used to love marijuana, until today. I took a grip of ambien this morning, but for some reason it didnt do much. Anyway, I went to the natural history museum, and the saber toothed tigers and mammoths were pretty trippy. (they seem so real) I was with this girl, 'D' who smokes a lot of weed. Anyway, I have been avoiding pot recently becuase I had addiction problems with it in the past, and I seemed to be doing pretty well restricting myself to alcohol and pills. But today I smoked pot. I only took about two hits, and as I came up I got that sickening pressure in the head and neck and shoulders, which most potheads know well. But for some reason this was much more intense then I remembered it. I started to gag at the foul taste the smoke left in my mouthe and throat (gullet?) and I hobbled over to the museum lawn, and started to vomit. I vomited for about 45 minutes, with intense hallucinations and paranoia, and still didnt come down from the pot for about 4 hours, which is a pretty long time for reefer... Anyways... I SHOULD NOT HAVE
MIXED AMBIEN AND POT!!!!
